item.title: The Rookie - Cut and Run - Review: Crossroads, Consequences, and No Easy Exits
item.description: “Cut and Run” is one of those episodes of The Rookie that feels deceptively busy on paper, yet lands with surprising emotional clarity. Yes, there are gang shootouts, courtroom chaos, and evidence-room disasters, but at its core, this episode is about choices. Big ones. The kind that quietly dismantle lives even when they’re made for the “right” reasons.
